extracted.intended_audience: prospective students and applicants interested in journalism, public relations, and related graduate and undergraduate programs
extracted.subtask_description: Program-level learning goals and curricular emphases for journalism and public relations degrees at USC Annenberg, describing the skills, ethical commitments, and experiential opportunities students are expected to develop.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadline-driven multimedia journalism (cross-platform stories)
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop into a deadline-driven multimedia journalist producing cross-platform stories in a converged news environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on speed and accuracy under deadlines, ability to craft stories for multiple platforms (print, web, audio, video), and adapting reporting to a converged newsroom.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public relations advocacy informed by audience insights
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare to advocate on behalf of a person, brand or organization by executing strategies informed by audience insights, and producing multiplatform storytelling grounded in ethical frameworks and data intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combines strategy, audience research/data intelligence, multiplatform content creation, and ethical decision-making in PR campaigns.

rubrics_metrics.name: PR leadership and adaptation to emerging technologies
rubrics_metrics.description: Evolve and lead the PR industry as emerging technologies expand the ways organizations communicate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on innovation, strategy, management skills, and the ability to leverage new communication technologies in organizational contexts (online MS program emphasis).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specialized long-form reporting grounded in content-area expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: Produce high-level, long-form reporting grounded in content-area expertise developed by taking courses across the university.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cultivate domain knowledge through interdisciplinary coursework so reporting is deeply informed, enabling investigative or long-form pieces with subject-matter authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arts and culture specialized journalism
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn to report on and magnify the arts as a critical aspect of culture while building multimedia journalism skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine cultural literacy with multimedia storytelling techniques to elevate arts coverage and contextualize its cultural importance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rigorous journalistic and ethical standards across platforms
rubrics_metrics.description: Guided by rigorous journalistic and ethical standards, report, write and produce news stories across platforms — while harnessing emerging technologies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritizes ethics, accuracy, and professional standards applied to multiplatform production and the use of new tools and technologies in reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brand messaging, content strategy, and social media campaign skills
rubrics_metrics.description: From developing brand messages to establishing a content strategy to implementing social media campaigns, learn how to advocate on behalf of a person, brand or organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical skills in messaging, strategic planning, and execution on social platforms as part of PR/advertising training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to diversity, complexity, and dignity in storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: An embrace of the world’s complexity, attentiveness to all manners of difference, and respect for the dignity of every human being.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curriculum and pedagogical mission to value diverse perspectives, amplify underrepresented voices, and practice inclusive, respectful journalism and PR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blend of critical theory and ethical practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Faculty provide a unique blend of critical theory and ethical practice that prepares students for careers in a culture in which their stories and messages carry greater influence than ever before.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integrates scholarly analysis and applied ethical training so students can think critically about media roles while practicing professional standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hands-on experiential training (newsroom, classroom, incubator)
rubrics_metrics.description: Our state-of-the-art media center allows students to cover breaking news, create high-impact journalism on multiple platforms, produce podcasts, and collect and integrate audience analytics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes practical, experiential learning using facilities and tools for real-world reporting, production, podcasting, and data-driven audience measurement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Student-led professional practice and portfolio development
rubrics_metrics.description: Annenberg Media, an entirely student-led team of journalists has produced award-winning coverage on topics such as politics, sports, entertainment, culture, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Opportunities for students to run newsroom operations, produce publishable work, and build portfolios that demonstrate professional standards and impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry engagement and career development via the Center for Public Relations
rubrics_metrics.description: The Center for Public Relations connects corporations, agencies, academics and students to define the future of the public relations industry and to develop those who will shape it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Networking, practitioner engagement, and research-practice partnerships aimed at preparing students for leadership roles in PR and related industries.
